scripts.build: npm run dictionary:build && npm run dictionary:validate && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json eslint.config.js README.md "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/**/*.ts" "data/curated/**/*.json"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json eslint.config.js README.md "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/**/*.ts" "data/curated/**/*.json"
